Name: Magic Tomes
Author: ponderosaMods
Description:
[size=4][b]Description[/b][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8]This mod adds magic tomes to the game. The tomes are items, each with its own unique powers.[/color]

[size=4][b]Installation instructions[/b][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8]1. Install SMAPI                                                                                                                                                                                            2. Download and unzip this mod into your Stardew Valley/Mods folder
3. Launch the game through SMAPI                                                                                                                                                              - Optionally install Generic Mod Config Menu to toggle the mod on/off from the in-game options menu.[/color]

[size=4][b]Main features[/b][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8]Adds magic tome items that grant special powers. Tomes can be bought from Wizard for 50,000g.[/color]
[color=#D4D4D8]  - Warp Tome: Teleport to locations across the world[/color]
[color=#D4D4D8]  - Bomb Tome: Spawn any known bomb at the Farmer's location[/color]
[color=#D4D4D8]  - Recipe Tome: Learn any unknown recipe[/color]
[color=#D4D4D8]  - Transmutation Tome: Transmute metals to higher or lower rarity. Works on ores and bars.[/color]
[color=#D4D4D8]  - Health Tome: Heals the Farmer of 10 HP when used[/color]

[size=4][b]Requirements[/b][/size]
- SMAPI 4.0 or later                                                                                                                                                                                    
- Stardew Valley 1.6 or later                          
- Generic Mod Config Menu (optional — for the in-game enable/disable toggle) 

[size=4][b]Shout outs[/b][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8]Thank you MeliponaPlays for the inspiration. Thanks to the SMAPI and Harmony teams for making Stardew modding as accessible as it is. Coding Assistance by Claude. [/color]

Manifest.Name: Magic Tomes
Manifest.Description: Five arcane tomes sold by the Wizard: Warp (teleportation), Transmutation (ore/bar conversion), Recipe (learn crafting recipes), Bomb (conjure explosives), and Healing (restore HP). Optional GMCM support.
